title: Text traffic got a steadier pace
summary:
The text API got steadier traffic handling, clearer responses, and a bigger model lineup, while contributing through GitHub became easier to find.

The text API limit rose from 20 to 40 requests per minute, while a separate queue now starts requests at least three seconds apart for each IP group. Access rules and request handling were tightened, and feed events stopped including requester IP addresses.

`openai-large` added GPT-4o for chat and image analysis alongside the existing GPT-4o-mini-backed `openai` model. Image-analysis examples cover URLs, base64 images, and Python; requested temperature now reaches the OpenAI generation path.

Text generation tracking was brought into line with image analytics. Errors now return structured JSON, empty message arrays get a 400 response, and invalid-message errors no longer echo submitted values. More backend tests and a pull-request test workflow help keep those behaviors checked.

Web-search requests gained a search-specific default prompt, Poly's prompt clarified its knowledge cutoff, and the architecture diagram was updated to reflect model routing. The text model list also dropped `qwen-coder`.
